get.summary:
GET /api/v1/auth/me
Returns authenticated user profile with resolved permissions for current org
Display a listing of the employees

path.description: Base path for paginator generated URLs.

per_page.description: Number of items shown per page.

to.description: Number of the last item in the slice.

total.description: Total number of items being paginated.

post.summary: Store a newly created employee in storage

put.summary: Update the specified employee in storage

delete.summary: Remove the specified employee from storage

get.summary:
GET /api/v1/modules
Lists modules the current user can access.
Filters by: org active modules ∩ role-assigned modules.
Super admins see all organization modules

GET /api/v1/permissions
List all available permissions grouped by module

put.summary:
PUT /api/v1/roles/{role}/permissions
Assign / Sync permissions to a role

PUT /api/v1/roles/{role}/menus
Sync Sidebar Menus and Submenus to a role

get.summary:
GET /api/v1/sidebar
Returns the role-filtered, module-scoped sidebar for the current user + organization.
Optional: ?module={slug} to filter sidebar to a specific module

pivot.description: If pivoting relation is loaded on the org, we can show it

errors.description: A detailed description of each field that failed validation.
